strategies.title: A-share trend breakout
strategies.summary: Buys a completed-close breakout and exits on a trailing trend reversal or fixed loss limit.
assumptions: One A-share daily symbol is released one completed bar at a time.
Orders are requested for the next bar open by the strategy host.

parameters.name: BREAKOUT_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the breakout high

parameters.name: TREND_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the exit average

parameters.name: STOP_LOSS_BPS
parameters.meaning: loss limit measured from the highest observed close

parameters.name: LOT_SIZE
parameters.meaning: A-share order quantity

strategies.title: A-share research short
strategies.summary: A labelled research-only short strategy that opens after a completed-close downside break and covers on reversal or loss limit.
assumptions: This is labelled research_short and requires an A-share account that explicitly enables that simulation mode.
One daily symbol is released one completed bar at a time.
Orders are requested for the next bar open by the strategy host.

parameters.name: BREAKDOWN_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the breakdown low

parameters.name: COVER_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the cover average

parameters.name: STOP_LOSS_BPS
parameters.meaning: loss limit measured above the short entry close

parameters.name: LOT_SIZE
parameters.meaning: A-share order quantity

strategies.title: A-share three-symbol rotation
strategies.summary: Ranks completed-session momentum across a fixed three-symbol universe and rotates the shared-cash position into the leader.
assumptions: Every session streams AAA.XSHG, BBB.XSHG, and CCC.XSHG before the next session begins, with session_end true on the final bar.
The strategy ranks only when session_end marks a completed session containing all three symbols.
The engine executes rotation intents against one shared-cash account; a rotation emits close before open.

parameters.name: UNIVERSE
parameters.meaning: fixed symbols ranked at every completed session

parameters.name: MIN_MOMENTUM_BPS
parameters.meaning: risk floor below which the strategy holds cash

parameters.name: LOT_SIZE
parameters.meaning: A-share order quantity per selected symbol

parameters.name: MOMENTUM_PERIODS
parameters.meaning: completed-session close-to-close momentum period

strategies.title: Crypto trend crossover
strategies.summary: Opens a linear-perpetual long when a fast completed-close average leads a slow average and exits on reversal or loss limit.
assumptions: One crypto linear-perpetual symbol is released one completed bar at a time.
Orders are requested for the next bar open by the strategy host.
The strategy uses whole contract quantities.

parameters.name: FAST_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the fast average

parameters.name: SLOW_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the slow average

parameters.name: STOP_LOSS_BPS
parameters.meaning: loss limit measured from entry close

parameters.name: CONTRACTS
parameters.meaning: linear-perpetual order quantity

strategies.title: Crypto mean reversion
strategies.summary: Buys a completed-close discount to its rolling mean and exits at a recovery target or loss limit.
assumptions: One crypto linear-perpetual symbol is released one completed bar at a time.
Orders are requested for the next bar open by the strategy host.
The strategy uses whole contract quantities.

parameters.name: MEAN_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the reference mean

parameters.name: ENTRY_DISCOUNT_BPS
parameters.meaning: discount below the mean needed to enter

parameters.name: RECOVERY_BPS
parameters.meaning: gain from entry close needed to exit

parameters.name: STOP_LOSS_BPS
parameters.meaning: loss limit from entry close

parameters.name: CONTRACTS
parameters.meaning: linear-perpetual order quantity

strategies.title: Crypto breakout
strategies.summary: Buys a completed-close high breakout and exits after a trend reversal or fixed loss limit.
assumptions: One crypto linear-perpetual symbol is released one completed bar at a time.
Orders are requested for the next bar open by the strategy host.
The strategy uses whole contract quantities.

parameters.name: BREAKOUT_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the breakout high

parameters.name: EXIT_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: completed closes used for the exit average

parameters.name: STOP_LOSS_BPS
parameters.meaning: loss limit measured from the highest observed close

parameters.name: CONTRACTS
parameters.meaning: linear-perpetual order quantity
